How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of USDT payment gateways involves a combination of technologies, including Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments. Cloudflare Pages serves as the hosting platform, while Cloudflare Workers handle the backend logic, automating tasks such as payment processing and order fulfillment. NOWPayments, the payment gateway, facilitates cryptocurrency transactions, converting USDT to USD in real-time. The entire process is seamless, with automatic webhook notifications firing the moment a payment is confirmed on-chain. By leveraging these technologies, creators can build a sovereign digital commerce stack that operates independently of traditional payment processors.
